floorPlans.introduction: Explore the four-, five- and six-bedroom estate villas. Each sheet shows all published levels of that layout, including mirrored versions where available.
floorPlans.note: The figure beside the selector is the saleable area of the home. The original sheet lists the plot area separately. Confirm both figures for the specific villa.

review.images: 7 native developer renders from the named The Orchard brochure pages. The five-bedroom rendering was matched visually to the composed brochure page because the extracted page objects also include art from the adjacent six-bedroom page.
review.location: The complete physical page 28 marks the enclave separately from the rest of Sobha City. The road corridor and Al Bahiya are from Sobha’s 11 April 2026 release (https://sobharealty.com/media-center/press-releases/sobha-city-abu-dhabis-new-nature-led-waterfront-living-community). Five existing destinations use the official project page’s approximate community journeys. The proposed theme park is outside the existing destinations shown here.
review.floorPlans: 10 full original sheets, including distinct mirrored designs and their own plot ranges. The displayed saleable area was read from the visible panel on every sheet. Plot area remains visible on the source.

unavailable: Verified enclave entrance coordinates and contractual dimensions for a specific villa. Directions resolve by project name.
